requirements.title: UART1 Hardware Initialization
requirements.description: The device library shall initialize the UART1 hardware interface at a caller-specified baud rate.
requirements.rationale: Brief: device_lib provides the UART1 hardware abstraction consumed by gps_lib for NMEA reception on Pico2.

requirements.title: UART1 Initialization Status Reporting
requirements.description: The device library shall return a status code indicating success or failure from UART1 initialization.
requirements.rationale: Brief: enables POST and continuous health to observe whether the UART hardware came up successfully.

requirements.title: Non-Blocking UART1 Read
requirements.description: The device library shall return immediately from a UART1 read with the bytes currently available.
requirements.rationale: Brief: deterministic TDM scheduling requires non-blocking reads so apps run at fixed rates.

requirements.title: UART1 Buffered Reception
requirements.description: The device library shall buffer received UART1 bytes and report a status when ring overflow drops bytes.
requirements.rationale: Brief: GPS NMEA arrives continuously between scheduled reads; data persists until next read, and overflow must be observable to callers per PM Decision 4 (sprint 2026-05-02).

requirements.title: UART1 Read Null-Pointer Rejection
requirements.description: The device library shall return a null-pointer error status when UART1 read receives a null buffer.
requirements.rationale: Brief: explicit error paths required; no silent failures or undefined behavior on bad inputs.

requirements.title: UART1 Read Byte Count Reporting
requirements.description: The device library shall report the byte count copied to the caller buffer per UART1 read.
requirements.rationale: Brief: callers must know how many bytes were returned to advance their parsing state deterministically.

requirements.title: UART1 Caller-Buffered Write
requirements.description: The device library shall transmit a caller-supplied byte buffer over UART1 and report bytes written.
requirements.rationale: Brief: lora_lib drives the RYLR896 LoRa modem via AT commands over UART1; PM Decision 5 (sprint 2026-05-02).
